limits: Cold means cold GPU weight cache; OS file pages may already be warm. Mode order and desktop load affect timing.
Synchronous CPU-to-GPU shell streaming, no prefetch and no KV cache. Peak covers initialization and all benchmark cases.
CPU backing retains every streamed shell weight; full model storage is required. Process RSS is reported separately.
Full core blocks and full shared interfaces are hot; extra resident non-core bytes are reported separately from the logical 15% core.
Runtime equivalence covers fixed validation prompts and a short generation check, not the full quality evaluation.
Streaming is a general residency mechanism; VRAM reduction alone does not establish an accuracy gain or architectural novelty.

core_reuse.interpretation: Positive paired gain means selected learned core-transformer changes help the unsteered outer relative to restoring those same slices to INITIAL. This is a conditional, post-selection ablation; it does not isolate which training loss caused any gain or establish controller usefulness.

restore_scope.included: Selected core attention projections, both in-layer norms, four complete MLPs and the selected neurons of the final core MLP.
restore_scope.excluded: Embedding rows, output-head rows, final norm, partial-layer shell neurons and every other outer parameter remain selected/trained.
restore_scope.interpretation: An intervention on learned transformer changes in the shared core, not deletion of the core or a test of all core parameters.

core_change_evidence.interpretation: Core transformer slices changed. The paired intervention below tests their conditional contribution to the selected outer model; a positive effect is not assumed.

reasoning_test_outer_disabled.protocol: Scaffolded constrained free-running trace. Fixed format tokens; state argmax among ten digit tokens; final argmax among contextual A/B. Predicted digits, never gold past values, are fed back.
Scaffolded constrained free-running trace. Fixed format tokens; state argmax among ten digit tokens; final argmax among contextual A/B. Predicted digits, never gold past values, are fed back.

reasoning_test_steered.protocol: Scaffolded constrained free-running trace. Fixed format tokens; state argmax among ten digit tokens; final argmax among contextual A/B. Predicted digits, never gold past values, are fed back.
reasoning_test_steered.interpretation: Exploratory distribution shift: controller trained on final-answer states is applied to generated intermediate-state tokens.

reasoning_test.activation_aware_interpretation: This policy is identical to always_stay; it provides no evidence of activation-specific route selection.

interpretation: Primary question: does the steered full outer model improve over the same selected model with steering disabled?
Cross-checkpoint gains also include ordinary adaptation; they do not isolate controller value.
Always-turn is a fixed-action control. Matching it is not evidence that conditional routing adds value.
Positive paired gains favor the first named arm. Accuracy is a fraction; NLL gains are reductions in nats per answer.
Intervals use 10000 paired complete-program bootstrap draws, seed 2026; no correction for multiple comparisons.
Point estimates alone do not establish an improvement. No standalone core accuracy is used.
Optional core restoration tests learned core-transformer contribution conditional on the selected outer weights; it does not identify which loss caused a gain.
